cmd: ethtool -C eth0 tx-usecs-irq 6 sample-interval 5 tx-frames-low 4 cqe-mode-tx on tx-aggr-max-frames 8
desc: corner: dev=eth0 arx=absent atx=absent rxu=absent rxf=absent txu=absent txf=absent irq=tx-usecs-irq rate=sample-interval lowhigh=tx-frames-low cqe=txon aggr=frames rxcqe=absent
